headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 14, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 9-6 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Iván Herrera leading the charge at the plate. Herrera's impressive performance included two home runs and three RBIs in just three at-bats. In other action, the New York Yankees took down the Toronto Blue Jays 3-1 behind Paul Goldschmidt's 9th home run of the season, and the Washington Nationals cruised past the Seattle Mariners 8-3 behind a strong performance from their offense.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Michael Helman, who was placed on the 10-day injured list by the Texas Rangers, and José Ramírez, who was placed on the 10-day injured list by the Cleveland Guardians due to a left hamate fracture. Other players on the injured list include Keaton Winn, Freddy Fermin, Vinnie Pasquantino, Evan Carter, Wilber Dotel, and Jack Flaherty.

The Cleveland Guardians traded RF Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox for Future Considerations, while the Chicago White Sox traded RF Derek Hill and Other Considerations to the Philadelphia Phillies for CF Dylan Campbell and 2B Jose Colmenares. The Milwaukee Brewers traded RHP Jacob Waguespack to the Detroit Tigers.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Twins 9-6**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 9-6 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Iván Herrera leading the charge at the plate. Herrera's impressive performance included two home runs and three RBIs in just three at-bats.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Blue Jays 3-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 3-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Paul Goldschmidt leading the offense. Goldschmidt hit his 9th home run of the season, a fly ball to left field that scored Cody Bellinger.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Orioles 9-3**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a 9-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Randy Vásquez earning the win after 5.0 innings pitched.

top_news.title: **Nationals Cruise Past Mariners 8-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a decisive 8-3 victory over the Seattle Mariners, behind a strong performance from their offense. Colt Emerson led the Nationals' batting effort with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Pirates 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 4-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Liam Hicks and Heriberto Hernández contributing key hits for the winning team. Max Meyer and Paul Skenes were standout performers on the mound for the Marlins.

top_news.title: **Nationals Rout Mariners 10-1**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dominated the Seattle Mariners in a lopsided 10-1 victory. Impact hitters for the Nationals included James Wood and Keibert Ruiz.

top_news.title: **Rangers CF Michael Helman Lands on 10-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers center fielder Michael Helman has been placed on the 10-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Cleveland Guardians Make Trade Debut**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians made their first trade of the season on June 11, 2026, sending RF Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox in exchange for future considerations.
